## June 2026
- Runtime: Increased default service quotas (5,000 active sessions us-east-1/us-west-2; 200 TPS InvokeAgentRuntime; 400 TPM container sessions). [limit bump — NOT reportable]
- **Web Search Tool — GA** [reported 2026-07-05, AISPM HIGH]. Managed tool grounding agents in live web with zero data egress; built-in MCP connector target on Gateway. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/web-search.html
- **Managed Knowledge Base — GA** [reported 2026-07-05, AISPM HIGH]. Fully managed RAG KB queryable via Gateway (pre-built target type); six native connectors (S3, SharePoint, Confluence, Google Drive, OneDrive, Web Crawler); managed vector storage; hybrid + multimodal retrieval. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/knowledge-base.html
- **AgentCore Policy — Bedrock Guardrails support** [reported 2026-07-05, AIRT MEDIUM]. Guardrails evaluate agent-action outputs + gateway-target inputs at the gateway layer, outside agent code. Distinct from prior Cedar Policy. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/gateway-guardrails.html
- **Gateway: HTTP passthrough / Inference / Runtime-agent targets (GA)** [reported 2026-07-05, AISPM MEDIUM]. New connector/target classes: passthrough (front APIs, external MCP servers, A2A agents, custom inference endpoints); inference (model providers, per-model token limits); runtime-agent targets GA. Sources: gateway-target-http-passthrough.html, gateway-target-inference-connector.html, gateway-target-http-runtime.html
- **Runtime: Interactive Shells (Terminals)** [reported 2026-07-05, AIRT MEDIUM]. Persistent stateful shell sessions (env/cwd/processes persist; up to 10 per runtime session). Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-get-started-command-shell.html
- AgentCore Harness — GA [reported 05-21; GA confirmed 07-04]. Built-in memory, LiteLLM/Bedrock Mantle providers, AWS skills catalog, evals+optimization, versioning/endpoints, Strands export.
- Recommendations / Batch Evaluations / A-B Testing — GA (Optimization) [reported 05-18/05-21].
- Gateway: Enforce inbound traffic from the gateway (SourceArn / allowedWorkloadConfiguration) [security control, below bar].
- Failure Insights — public preview [below bar]. optimization-insights.html
- Step Functions <-> AgentCore harness native integration [below bar]. harness-step-functions.html
- AgentCore achieves SOC 1/2/3 compliance [compliance, not reportable].
- Identity: reference existing AWS Secrets Manager secret ARNs in Credential Providers [below bar].
- AgentCore CLI (v0.19.0) + CDK: Payments support [Payments SERVICE already reported 05-18/05-21; CLI/CDK GA tooling — not new].

## May 2026 [baseline via release-notes]
- CDK AgentCore L2 constructs stable; Gateway MCP Sessions; Gateway Response Streaming (SSE); Gateway Elicitation Pass-Through; Gateway Sampling Messages; Gateway Progress/Logging Notifications; Harness + Runtime BYO filesystem (S3 Files / EFS); Agent Performance Loop (Optimization/Batch Eval/User Simulation); GovCloud (US-West) GA; AgentCore Payments (preview); Runtime Custom Header Passthrough. [reported 05-18/05-21]

## April 2026 [reported in prior scans]
- VPC egress (Identity/Gateway/Runtime); Node.js direct code deploy; Optimization loop preview; Identity OBO token exchange; São Paulo/Canada region expansion; Memory metadata filtering; Harness preview; AgentCore MCP Server in awslabs/mcp; CLI Agent Inspector; AgentCore Registry preview; cross-account observability; Browser OS-level interaction (InvokeBrowser); Gateway 3LO GA; LangChain Deep Agents + AG-UI/CopilotKit partnerships.

## March–Jul 2025 [older, cached]: Evaluations GA; Policy GA (Cedar); CLI GA; PrivateLink; Stateful MCP in Runtime; AG-UI protocol; Payments concepts; Web Bot Auth; MCP servers as Gateway targets; GA (Oct 2025); initial preview (Jul 2025).
